ios.build: set -euo pipefail; fvm flutter build ios --release --no-codesign; fvm flutter build ios --simulator --debug
ios.simulatorCaveat: Flutter builds only debug apps for the iOS simulator (JIT, no AOT, debug asserts on), so simulator numbers are not comparable with other frameworks' Release simulator builds; use them for correctness only. The Release build is the unsigned device app.
